approvals.title: WattNot run 20261027_091706: try power caps and vLLM settings on NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3
approvals.summary: Try these changes to take measurements: power cap 200-700 W on GPU [0]; restart vLLM with different batch / KV cache / quantization settings; shed up to 35.0% for up to 300 s; run a MoE model with adaptive top-k (router mass 0.5-0.999) next to the normal top-k, in a separate process. Every change is put back when the session ends. measure each setting against the baseline; everything is restored afterwards
